effect.fr: Tenu: Change Silvallié dans sa forme Glace.  Change le type de Coup Varia-Type en Glace.
effect.en: Held: Changes Silvally to its Ice form.  Changes Multi-Attack’s type to Ice.

flavor.ko: 얼음타입의 데이터가 들어 있는 메모리. 특정 포켓몬이 지니면 타입이 바뀐다.
flavor.en: A memory disc that contains Ice-type data. It changes the type of the holder if held by a certain species of Pokémon.
